clips.title: The story
paras: In Hillsbrad, a case of Fallrook Varietal is bound for Dun Garok. The brew-kin there miss the Fallrook family's vineyards, and a sack of Homebrew Hops comes back in trade.
The Fallrook cellars still hold cases of wine, though most of its best bottled years are long gone. The Dun Garok brew-kin miss the family's vineyards too, and a trade has been arranged with them.
You carry the case southeast to Dun Garok, where the brew-kin gather beside the fireplace at the base of their fort. In return, you bring back a sack of their Homebrew Hops.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Worked a bit o' a trade with the Dun Garok brew-kin. We're not the only ones missin' the vineyards of the Fallrook family, it seems! Most o' the best bottled years are long since drank, but we do have cases of the wine still in the cellars.
Bring this case of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in the southeast and leave it with 'em by their gatherin' fireplace at the bottom of their fort.
In return, carry a sack o' the Homebrew Hops back with ye.
That keep is the closest thing to home around here!
